{{Top}}
The '''T-s9a targeting computer''' was developed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] for use in the company's [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]].

==History==
T-S9a was, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the most advanced and accurate [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computers]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] for starfighters, tied only by the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] targeting computer. The [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] was the starfighter that used it as standard equipment, and was the only Targeting Computer that allowed the Interceptor to do complex maneuvers, and still accurately splash enemy starfighters.
